preflight_layers: Before the start it waits for the device; if it does not come back, the program is suspended and the reason recorded.
At the start, manual runs too: with the device offline the run is cancelled.
At the finish: the buckets are reset only if the device is online.
dashboard.si_lead_hint: minutes before the start; for every controller
dashboard.engine_off_hint: Programs and switches here are not sent to Irrigation Unlimited. Open the integration, choose Configure and turn on Engine active.
dashboard.logging_hint: plain text file of runs and faults
dashboard.dashboard_sub: Hand edits last until the next configuration change.
